name: Action Against Hunger USA
mission: Action Against Hunger’s mission is to save the lives of children and their families. We are there for them before and after disaster strikes. We enable people to provide for themselves, see their children grow up strong, and for whole communities to prosper. We constantly search for more effective solutions, while sharing our knowledge and expertise with the world. We push for long-term change.
theoryOfChange: Hunger is predictable, preventable, and treatable. We tackle the root causes of hunger, helping people earn incomes and improve food security.

strengths_deep_dive: Action Against Hunger USA demonstrates consistent fiscal efficiency in its direct service operations. In FY2024, the organization maintained a <cite id="4">Program expense ratio of 90.4%</cite>, directing the vast majority of its resources toward field projects in water, sanitation, and nutrition [8]. This financial stewardship beats the peer program ratio median of 83.3% and earns high rating agency marks, including an <cite id="15">overall score of 89.0/100 from Charity Navigator</cite>. Furthermore, its delivery model yields a highly direct impact, serving communities at an average cost of <cite id="14">$5.46 per beneficiary</cite> across multiple crisis zones [2].
rich_narrative.summary: Action Against Hunger USA delivers direct nutritional, health, and emergency relief services to combat extreme poverty and global hunger [8]. In FY2024, the organization managed <cite id="2">Total Revenue of $160,756,238</cite>, down 20% from $201,188,874 in FY2023 [3]. Financial efficiency remains a primary operational strength, reflected in a <cite id="4">Program expense ratio of 90.4%</cite>, which surpasses the 83.3% peer median [15]. By deploying direct service delivery models in high-need regions like Afghanistan, Chad, and Somalia, the charity achieves a exceptionally low cost of <cite id="14">$5.46 per beneficiary</cite> while reaching millions of individuals [14]. Public rating platforms acknowledge these operational standards, evidenced by an <cite id="15">overall score of 89.0/100 from Charity Navigator</cite> and full compliance with <cite id="15">BBB Wise Giving Alliance standards</cite>.
